explainBack.question: Why might ChatGPT give a weaker answer when I ask it something from the floating pet controls than when I ask the same thing inside my project?
explainBack.answer: Because a chat started from the floating controls begins outside any project, it cannot see the files and instructions saved in that project. ChatGPT can only use the context the surrounding product hands to the chat, and the floating panel hands it nothing from your project. The pet itself changes nothing either way — it is appearance only. To get the project's files and instructions into the conversation, you must start the chat from that project in the main app.
explainBack.expectedEvidence: An accurate answer must cite the context boundary (floating-controls chats are outside a project, P006), the general principle that a chat only uses supplied context (P009), and the appearance-only role of the pet (P003).
explainBack.assessment: The article fully supports this answer: P006 states the boundary and the remedy, P009 supplies the causal principle, and P003 rules out the pet as a variable. A reader relying only on this artifact can reconstruct the causal chain correctly.

unseenTransfer.scenario: A marketing director keeps her brand style guide and past campaign briefs in a ChatGPT project. During a video call, she uses the floating pet controls to fire off a quick chat: 'Draft three taglines in our house style.' The results ignore the style guide entirely, and a colleague suggests she switch from the Mini setting to the cat pet because 'the pets seem to give better answers.'
unseenTransfer.question: Why did the taglines ignore the style guide, and would choosing a pet instead of Mini help?
unseenTransfer.answer: The taglines ignored the guide because her quick chat started from the floating controls, which begin outside any project — the style guide and briefs were never part of the chat's context, so the model could not use them. Switching from Mini to a pet would change nothing: OpenAI states a pet changes appearance only, not how ChatGPT completes tasks. The fix is to open her project in the main app and start the tagline chat there, so the guide and briefs are supplied as context.
